15:16.text: And indeed, We have put the big stars in the heaven and We beautified it for the beholders.

15:18.text: who steals the hearing then he is pursued by a clear flaming fire.

15:19.text: And the earth We have spread out, and have placed therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein all kinds of things in due proportion.

15:20.text: And We have provided therein means of living, for you and for those whom you provide not
[moving (living) creatures, cattle, beasts, and other animals]

15:21.text: And there is not a thing, but with Us are the stores thereof. And We send it not down except in a known measure.

15:22.text: And We send the winds fertilizing
(to fill heavily the clouds with water)
to descend from the sky, and We give it to you to drink, and it is not you who are the owners of its stores
[i.e. to give water to whom you like or to withhold it from whom you like]

15:23.text: And certainly We! We it is Who give life, and cause death,

15:24.text: And indeed, We know the first generations of you who had passed away, and indeed, We know the present generations of you
, and also those who will come afterwards.

15:25.text: And verily, your Lord will gather them together. Truly, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.

15:26.text: And indeed, We created man from dried

15:27.text: And the jinn, We created aforetime from the smokeless flame of fire.

15:28.text: when your Lord said to the angels: "I am going to create a man

15:29.text: "So, when I have fashioned him completely and breathed into him
the soul which I created for him, then fall

15:30.text: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together.

15:31.text: - he refused to be among the prostrators.
